text:
Maya: Quick design review please — spotted a couple UX hazards in autoscale/capacity controls. Main issues: the min/max stepper label is ambiguous (users think it only applies to the current pool) and the pool-search suggestions clear too aggressively when typing. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/autoscale-v2 :mag:

Ken: Saw the same in the guerrilla tests. One user raised min for a cluster thinking it affected only a single pool and doubled spend. Need clearer scope messaging and maybe a confirmation.

Sasha: Copy idea: change "Min" to "Min capacity (cluster)" plus microcopy under the control: "Applies to all selected pools unless a single pool is chosen." If layout is tight, swap to an info icon with accessible tooltip.

Jamal: Prefer the tooltip approach for compact UI. Also accessibility note: stepper buttons currently don't announce changes to screen readers on hold. We should trigger an aria-live update like "Min capacity set to X GPUs" and debounce it.

design-bot: Contrast check: stepper value (light gray) fails AA on white background. Suggest #243A57 or semibold weight (600). :warning:

Ken: Pool search bug: when there are many pools (>100) we debounce remote queries but we clear client suggestions immediately, causing jitter. Options: keep last suggestions visible until new results arrive OR do a client-side prefix filter of cached results and show a "searching" indicator. I lean toward keeping suggestions until results come back.

Sasha: UX improvement: if typed name doesn't match any pool, show a contextual CTA like "Request pool" or "Create pool" based on role. Prevents dead-ends.

Maya: For SLO slider: keyboard support must include arrows for 1% steps and PageUp/PageDown for 10%. Also add an aria-describedby live summary: "SLO set to 98% — estimated throughput impact: +8% latency" generated from model/profile data.

Jamal: Implementation note for aria-live: reuse toaster announce util with polite politeness and debounce when slider moves rapidly. Pseudo:
```
announce(`SLO set to ${value}% — est. cost delta ${delta}%`, {politeness: 'polite'});
```
Ensure announcement fires on slider commit, not every incremental drag.

Sasha: Burst toggle microcopy: current "Allow burst" is terse and unclear. Try "Enable temporary burst capacity" with subtext "Automatically scales above max for short windows." Also move the toggle to the right side of the card to reduce accidental toggles on mobile.

Ken: Add a confirmation toast when burst is enabled that links to billing impact details. People leave it on and forget. Toast could say: "Burst enabled — View estimated monthly cost".

Maya: I'll add an a11y checklist to PR template: roles, aria-live, aria-describedby, keyboard nav, contrast, touch targets, and focus order.

design-bot: Figma notes created: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/autoscale-a11y. Color variants attached.

Maya: Owners: Jamal — aria-live & stepper announcements; Ken — pool-search suggestion persistence; Sasha — copy & mobile placement + mockups (post by EOD). Ken ETA for search patch?

Ken: I can push a small fix tomorrow morning and add tests to assert suggestions persist until server response.

Sasha: Will post compact and tooltip copy variants by EOD.

Maya: Follow-ups: (1) finalize copy for burst confirmation toast, (2) define when to show "Request/Create pool", (3) add unit test for stepper aria-live debounce. I'll file a ticket and assign owners. :thumbsup:

design-bot: Ticket REDWOOD-1428 created: "Autoscale: clarify min/max scope, pool search persistence, burst microcopy & a11y" — https://tracker.example.com/REDWOOD-1428
